title: Fix Mcp App Tools to Return Rich Svg Diagram Instead of Json
description: MCP app tools like show_design return raw JSON instead of rich visual content. Fixed to return CallToolResult with SVG diagram ImageContent, text summary, and proper structuredContent.
summary: Fixed MCP app tools to return rich visual content instead of raw JSON. Tools now return proper CallToolResult with: (1) SVG diagram as ImageContent showing pieces as circles and connections as lines with diff/selection coloring and type name tooltips, (2) text summary with mode/design/piece/connection counts, (3) structuredContent at the MCP protocol level. Added 3 selection tools (read/set/clear_current_selection) and 8 app tools (show_design, show_diagram, show_scene, show_diff, show_diagram_diff, select_pieces, select_connections, select_pieces_and_connections). Also started HTTP engine server in background during MCP stdio mode for future interactive app serving. Updated tool surface test. All 142 tests pass.
